display_long_description:
# Can you survive the chaos of the **CRAZYFISH KITCHEN**?
- **Fast paced meal creation** - Chop, stir, bake, and serve before time runs out!
- **Quirky grab mechanics** - No thumbs? No problem! Stretch, fling, and snatch your way to culinary glory.
- **Ever-changing challenges** - Each level brings new recipes, obstacles, and kitchen madness.

**Single player not enough? Team up with a friend and take multiplayer mayhem to the next level!**

Earn stars as you cook and use them to customize your chef! Unlock wacky new heads or stylish hats!

From chopping crisp lettuce to baking golden bread, you’ll tackle a variety of recipes. But don’t get too careless… one wrong move and the kitchen might just go up in flames!
# GRAB NOW, EVOLVE LATER

No thumbs? No problem! Snatch, scoop, and secure ingredients using just your controllers; who needs thumbs anyway?
[media]
# REACH BEYOND REASON

Dropped an item? Fear not! Launch items straight into your hands with a trigger pull and embrace your inner noodle-armed hero.
[media]
# CUTTING EDGE CUISINE

Grab a knife, chop those ingredients down to size, and try not to turn dinner into a disaster.
[media]
# FROM CEREAL TO CULINARY HERO

If cereal counts as cooking, this game is your redemption arc. Chop, add, cook, and serve. Just be careful about the fire...
[media]
# BAKING GONE WILD

Mix, bake... survive! Prep your ingredients, toss them in, and hope your creation doesn’t turn the stove into a bonfire. From sweet treats to savory experiments, only the brave, or lucky, will serve up perfection.
[media]
